metric_expectations.source_text: Out-of-sample Sharpe ≥ 1.0 net of modeled costs.
DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count.
Max drawdown ≤ 20% in any walk-forward fold.
Parameter sensitivity: ±25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline.

metric_expectations.notes: Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because OL-0012.metrics.gross_pnl <= 0, so the cost_drag_fraction as a fraction of gross PnL is not semantically interpretable as a pass/fail ratio.

metric_expectations.source_text: No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL.
metric_expectations.notes: Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because OL-0012.metrics does not include a 90-day contribution metric.
Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because OL-0012.metrics does not include free_parameter_count.

realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-10r uses a distinct final-local-data-year OOS window from 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. No separate IS metric convention is introduced; in_sample.sharpe records the same actual window Sharpe for schema continuity.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0012 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 requires DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count; OL-0012 records dsr below that threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0012 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity to keep Sharpe within 70% of baseline under +/-25% parameter shifts; OL-0012 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0012 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.

interpretation: WP-10t is a Stage 2 Path A REC append. REC-0023 derives from OL-0012 and reconciles against D2-006 only using committed D2-006 source text and copied OL metrics. It creates no EXP, REP, OL, LCH, registry, schema, validator, query-layer, runtime, config, dependency, data, or protected-path change. It does not satisfy REC-5: the selected exact segment H-004 / research_oos / post_wp_5b / d2_006_gates moves from 1 to 2 REC observations and remains below n >= 3. It creates no policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, promotion, or demotion authority, and makes no H-004 pre/post comparison claim.
